upcomingEvents.name: Innovation Galway Club Evening
upcomingEvents.description: Come build something. Bring a project you're already working on, start something completely new, find people to build with, or just come along and see what everyone else is making. There'll be workshops on pitching and demos throughout the evening, and experienced builders around if you need guidance. You don't need loads of experience, a team or even an idea before you arrive.

upcomingEvents.description: A hackathon we're running with ElevenLabs. We're still pulling the details together, check back soon.

upcomingEvents.name: Innovation Ireland Hackathon
upcomingEvents.description: One room. Everyone who builds something in Ireland, in the same place, for a weekend. Bring an idea or find one when you get there.
